title: Quentin and the Harbor
author: Ines Coldharbour
blurb: Hazel Amberdale, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, has spent seven years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must choose which family member gets the last berth before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
